headline: Energy North's Hefner's Way subdivision plan hearing continued at applicant's request.
summary: The plan covers 40 Sargent Street, 10 Gale Road, and 18 Gale Road, among other parcels. Energy North asked to continue the hearing to the regularly scheduled meeting of November 19th, 2026. Energy North also said 46 Millett Street is no longer part of the plan, so it was removed from the agenda. The time for the board to act was extended to December 31st.
decisions: Approved extending the time for the board to act to December 31st.
Continued the Hefner's Way public hearing to November 19th, 2026.
discussion: Hefner's Way site visit: Members said at least four missed the earlier site visit. They discussed a new visit, probably with the applicant, and times were to be circulated.
October 1st minutes: A member said a requested list of waivers did not appear in the minutes. Members discussed moving approval of the minutes to the next meeting.

decision_evidence.quote: That's my motion. I'll second. ... So, we have a motion by Jane Remsen, seconded by Doug Cook. And, roll call vote, please. ... And Member Rosen? Yes.
Okay, and I also move that we, um, continue the public hearing until November 19th, 2026. ... And he gives me his thumbs up.

decision_titles: Hefner's Way subdivision: time to act extended to December 31st
Hefner's Way public hearing, continued to November 19th, 2026
